title: Design: Bill To search keeps this customer first and never shows an empty list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-04-after-searching.png, bt-p2-05-after-no-match.png, bt-p3-18-after-counter-sale-not-offered.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Bill To field on the customer card.
  2. Type part of another customer's name (for example Vald).
  3. Replace the text with zzqx.
  4. Replace the text with the first word of the Counter Sale customer's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • The "(this customer)" row is first, then the matching customers A to Z, in a list as wide as the card under the field.

Step 3:

  • Only the "(this customer)" row shows; no "no results" message.

Step 4:

  • Only the "(this customer)" row shows: the Counter Sale customer is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
  • S3-R4: “With no match, the list shows only the "(this customer)" option.”
  • S1-N5: “Counter Sale never appears in the field's options.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "2 Bill a work order or part sale to someone else / 3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Searching" (This build), "No match" (This build), "Counter Sale not offered" (New, no before exists).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-04-after-searching.png
  • bt-p2-05-after-no-match.png
  • bt-p3-18-after-counter-sale-not-offered.png

  • “The "(this customer)" option is always listed, so the list is never empty.”
